agent_prediction.rationale:
**Antonelli on top, Hamilton chasing, Piastri rounds out the podium.**

Antonelli arrives at Barcelona with a 5-race win streak (China through Monaco) and a 66-point championship lead. He's been near-untouchable in race trim and starts as the heavy favourite at a circuit that rewards consistent fast laps over wheel-to-wheel chaos â€” exactly his profile. Both models agree (Stage 6: 30.9% win, Stage 9: 30.1% win), and there's no Monaco-style track-position lottery to bail anyone out.

Hamilton is the cleanest P2 pick: P2 in Monaco, P2 in Canada, sitting 2nd in the championship at 90 points. Ferrari has been the most consistent non-Mercedes car all season and Barcelona historically rewards a stable rear end on long corners, which suits the SF-26's strength.

For P3 I'm taking **Piastri over Norris/Verstappen**. McLaren brings a major European-opener upgrade package and Piastri has been the more consistent of the two MCL cars (P5 at Monaco from P7; Norris DNF'd with battery issue). Barcelona's high-speed corners suit MCL's aero efficiency. Verstappen had a 0-lap DNF at Monaco and qualifies well but his Red Bull race pace has slipped; Hadjar (RB) has been overperforming the car. Russell is wild-card upside but the form trajectory is wrong.

**Risk to this call:** hot conditions (34Â°C ambient, 50Â°C+ track) with Pirelli's softer compounds and front-left wear could push to 2 stops and create a strategy lottery â€” but at Barcelona that lottery usually still surfaces the fastest car, which is the Mercedes.
context: Antonelli leads championship 156 pts, +66 over Hamilton; won R2-R6 (China, Japan, Miami, Canada, Monaco).
Hamilton 90 pts (P2 in standings), Russell 88 pts (P3, struggling with form per his own admission).
Hot/dry forecast: ~34Â°C ambient, 50Â°C+ track, virtually no rain risk across the weekend.
Pirelli running a softer compound range than 2025; front-left degradation expected; likely 2-stop.
First true European round â€” multiple teams (notably McLaren and Aston Martin) bringing upgrade packages.
Verstappen DNF'd at Monaco lap 0 (engine), Norris DNF (battery); both arrive needing rebound results.
Composite model podium: Antonelli / Hamilton / Piastri matches my judgment; Stage 9 prefers Piastri over Verstappen for P3.
